box-office.module.name: Box office
box-office.module.description: Selling tickets: what is on sale and for how much, seats held and sold, reservations paid for at the desk, orders, tickets and the door.
box-office.settings.baskets.hold-for.lab: Hold seats in a basket for
box-office.settings.baskets.hold-for.hel: How long seats are kept for a buyer once they press Hold tickets. Changing the basket does not restart it. A performance can have its own length.
box-office.settings.orders.seat-cap.labe: Most tickets in one online order
box-office.settings.orders.seat-cap.help: The most tickets one person can book online in a single order. A performance can have its own limit.
box-office.settings.sales.close-before.l: Close online sales before the start
box-office.settings.sales.close-before.h: How long before a performance starts online sales close. Nothing means they stay open until it starts. A performance can have its own closing time.
box-office.settings.retention.holds.labe: Keep the label of a staff hold for
box-office.settings.retention.holds.help: How long after the performance a hold placed by staff keeps its label, such as the name of the guests it was for.
Set up sales for a performance
box-office.abilities.performance.exceed-: Sell more than the space holds
